name: Troubleshoot network connectivity
body: Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection. Restart the network adapter. Confirm whether other devices are affected. Record the error and escalate to IT support if connectivity is not restored.

name: Device will not power on
body: Check the approved power adapter and socket. Disconnect peripherals and retry. Do not open equipment under warranty; contact the authorized service provider.

name: Preventive maintenance essentials
body: Use the approved checklist, isolate equipment safely, record readings, and document issues before closing the work order.

name: Printer paper jams
body: Pause printing. Follow the manufacturer guide to remove paper safely. Inspect paper size and tray settings; record any repeated error.

name: Request application access
body: Raise a service request with application and business justification. Obtain the designated approver’s authorization before provisioning access.

name: Password and account support
body: Use the account password-change feature. Never share passwords in a ticket. Contact the administrator if the account is blocked.

name: HVAC low cooling checks
body: Confirm permitted thermostat settings and inspect filter condition. A trained technician must perform electrical or refrigerant checks.

name: Generator recurring alarms
body: Record the alarm code and conditions. Follow site safety procedures and notify the authorized maintenance team. Do not bypass safety interlocks.

name: Returning an assigned asset
body: Raise an asset return request, record serial and condition, and arrange a documented handover with the asset manager.

name: Asset retirement and disposal
body: Document the end-of-life reason and obtain approval from another authorized reviewer. Confirm data sanitization and finance closure before disposal.
